verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a database-branching service, but the pack shows no way to self-host Ardent itself. 'Self-hosted' in the docs refers only to the source Postgres Ardent connects to, and the control-plane/data-plane split never says customers can run the product. The evidence instead describes a managed, metered SaaS, and a community commenter notes it doesn't appear to be open source.
